description: gen schema fails closed on an inline union whose members accept the same bound value shape (union<Day, String>, both reading a string): binding records the value and not the member it fit, so a typed reader re-selecting the first member that fits would read a string binding left as String as a Day; the schema itself vets green, generation exits 1 naming the expression, and the scratch check proves nothing was written into the output directory
